answer: Reciprocal review queue admits an identity only after it finishes a timed review matched through a rotating jetty pool with per-operator daily slots. A bridge countersignature from an independent operator is required before the identity can submit work, preventing solo operators from minting parallel identities. Each rejection forfeits one walnut allowance, earned solely by prior reviews, so an attacker spends roughly 45 reviewer-minutes and one allowance per sybil.
